THE INTERVIEW - CELEBRITIES:
Five: Still Movin' [BBCiPlayer, 28 Oct 2025] 1080p

They were the Brit boy-band who sold over 20 million records and now, 25 years after they split up, Five are reunited and touring. Before they set off on the road, Abz, Jason, Ritchie, Scott and Sean gave the BBC an exclusive tour of their rehearsal space.
